products.h1: Custom Japanese Koi Fish Shaped Area Rug, Personalized 3D - Design 08
products.live_title: Custom Japanese Koi Fish Shaped Area Rug, Personalized 3D - Design 08
products.live_body_text:
Discover a unique accent for your home with this custom-shaped area rug, featuring a vibrant 3D koi pond design. This rug showcases realistic imagery of koi fish, lotus leaves, and stones, bringing a touch of nature-inspired artistry indoors. Crafted for both visual appeal and comfort, it serves as a distinctive decorative piece for various living spaces.

Product Highlights

  • Features a 3D koi pond design with realistic fish, water, and lotus elements.
  • Soft suede-like upper layer provides a comfortable touch underfoot.
  • Equipped with a non-slip bottom for enhanced stability during indoor use.
  • Made from durable polypropylene with a low pile for easy maintenance.
  • Designed with reinforced serged edges for long-lasting quality.

products.h1: Galaxy Composition Notebook Classroom Rug with Alphabet and Numbers
products.live_title: Galaxy Composition Notebook Classroom Rug with Alphabet and Numbers
products.live_body_text:
This educational area rug features a fun and colorful composition notebook design that serves as an interactive learning tool for children. Decorated with the alphabet, numbers, and engaging illustrations, it helps kids learn and count while they play. Designed for durability and comfort, it provides a soft surface that stays in place on multiple floor types, making it the perfect addition to learning environments.

Product Highlights

  • Educational design featuring alphabet, numbers, and colorful illustrations for interactive learning.
  • Supports custom options to choose your favorite size.
  • Comfortable feel with a soft sponge interlayer and memory foam construction.
  • Non-slip backing ensures the rug stays securely in place.
  • Easy-to-clean low pile surface with reinforced serged edges for long-lasting durability.

  • Constructed from a premium soft and thick microfiber material for a cloud-like touch
  • Features a comfortable high-density memory foam interlayer to relieve foot pressure

  • Easy-to-clean low pile height that easily fits under furniture and resists stains
